tei:div.tei:p: All this is truth and faithfulness and it is established unto us that He, the Lord, is our God and there is none beside Him and we are Israel, His people. It is He who frees us from the hand of kings, our King who redeems us from the palm of all oppressors. It is God who requites our enemies on our behalf and pays retribution to all pursuers of our soul. It is He who performs unfathomable deeds of grandeur, wonders without number. He who sets our soul in the course of life and does not allow our feet to falter. He who leads us over the heights of our adversaries and raises our condition above all who hate us. It is He who effects wonders for us and revenge on Pharaoh, signs and miracles in the land of the sons of Ham, who slays all the first-born of Egypt in His wrath and leads His people Israel from their midst to eternal freedom. It is He who causes His children to pass between the divisions of the Red Sea, their persecutors and their enemies did He drown in the depths. His children saw His strength, they praised and acknowledged His Name, they willingly accepted His dominion over them. Moses and the children of Israel answered in song to Thee with great rejoicing and they all said:

tei:p.tei:seg: Who is like Thee among the mighty, O Lord? Who is like Thee, glorious in holiness, awe-inspiring in fame, worker of wonder?

tei:div.tei:p: Thy children saw Thy kingdom when Thou didst divide the sea before Moses: this is my God, they answered and said: The Lord shall reign for ever and ever.
And it is said: For the Lord has freed Jacob and redeemed him from the hand of one stronger than he. Blessed art Thou, O Lord, who has redeemed Israel.
